teaser: "Who's going to run this when you're gone?" someone asks at choir practice, half joking, handing you the folder of music nobody else wants to organize. You're a life path 8, an ESFJ, and the question lands differently on you than it would on most. The 8 wants command of the material world — money, structure, who answers to whom. The ESFJ wants the room to hold together, warm and accounted for. In you, these pull toward the same chair: the one who keeps the books straight and keeps everyone fed at the same table, and rarely says which job costs more.
excerpt: Keeping the bill when it comes, before anyone else reaches for it — that habit belongs to this number, and in you an ESFJ turns it into a ritual rather than a one-off.
